claim: Declared Cauchy fibre stress times declared current projected cut area equals nominal stress times reference area
not_proved: The geometry or Nanson premises, a heterogeneous area integral, JavaScript arithmetic, equilibrium or physiology
assumptions: All parameters are real. J > 0 and fibre stretch > 0. Current projected area is defined as A0*J/stretch and Cauchy fibre stress as nominal*stretch/J. Positivity of A0 and nonnegative nominal stress are additional physical-use conditions, not hypotheses needed by this identity.
limitations: The geometry or Nanson premises, a heterogeneous area integral, JavaScript arithmetic, equilibrium or physiology.
statement_lean:
theorem material_cut_force (A0 nominal J stretch : ℝ)
    (hJ : 0 < J) (hstretch : 0 < stretch) :
    cauchyFiberStress nominal J stretch * currentProjectedArea A0 J stretch =
      nominal * A0

claim: Total area times area-weighted nominal stress equals the two-group force sum
not_proved: Measured fibre counts/areas, biological recruitment, lateral load sharing or the arbitrary-length JavaScript sum
assumptions: All parameters are real and n1*area1 + n2*area2 > 0. The two-group force and area-weighted stress are exactly the displayed definitions. Nonnegative fibre counts, areas and stresses are separate physical-use conditions.
limitations: Measured fibre counts/areas, biological recruitment, lateral load sharing or the arbitrary-length JavaScript sum.
statement_lean:
theorem parallel_area_aggregation (n1 area1 stress1 n2 area2 stress2 : ℝ)
    (hArea : 0 < n1 * area1 + n2 * area2) :
    (n1 * area1 + n2 * area2) *
      areaWeightedStress n1 area1 stress1 n2 area2 stress2 =
      parallelForce n1 area1 stress1 n2 area2 stress2

domain: Real scalar identity; physical use separately restricts a cosine to [0,1]
claim: Projecting force once equals multiplying stress by an already projected area
not_proved: A paper's PCSA definition, actual pennation, tendon routing or cancellation of transverse force
assumptions: Area, nominal stress and cosine are real scalars. The same cosine is used once, either on force or on area; physical use separately requires a cosine in [0,1] and an explicitly declared PCSA/stress convention.
limitations: A paper's PCSA definition, actual pennation, tendon routing or cancellation of transverse force.
statement_lean:
theorem projection_once (area nominal cosine : ℝ) :
    (nominal * area) * cosine = nominal * (area * cosine)
implementation: contributions/architecture-force/model.mjs (forceFromArea). Numerical contracts are checked separately; no implementation refinement proof.

claim: Two separate area/stress/cosine products equal the sum of separately projected group forces
not_proved: A three-dimensional aponeurosis solution or a calibrated fibre orientation distribution
assumptions: Counts, reference areas, nominal stresses and cosines are real scalars. The same two declared independent group terms occur on both sides; physical use separately requires meaningful nonnegative groups and cosines in [0,1].
limitations: A three-dimensional aponeurosis solution or a calibrated fibre orientation distribution.
statement_lean:
theorem two_group_projected_sum (n1 area1 stress1 cosine1 n2 area2 stress2 cosine2 : ℝ) :
    (n1 * area1) * (stress1 * cosine1) +
      (n2 * area2) * (stress2 * cosine2) =
    (n1 * area1 * stress1) * cosine1 +
      (n2 * area2 * stress2) * cosine2
implementation: contributions/architecture-force/model.mjs (aggregateTypes). Numerical contracts are checked separately; no implementation refinement proof.

domain: Real scalar identity with one shared internal force
claim: Summing two declared cell balances cancels the shared internal section force
not_proved: Equilibrium premises, compatible displacement, ECM stiffness or force generation
assumptions: Left, middle and right section forces and q1, q2 are real scalars. The adjacent cell expressions use one shared middle force with opposite signs. Zero cell balance and static equilibrium are additional premises, not conclusions.
limitations: Equilibrium premises, compatible displacement, ECM stiffness or force generation.
statement_lean:
theorem series_balance_telescopes (left middle right q1 q2 : ℝ) :
    (middle - left + q1) + (right - middle + q2) =

domain: Real scalar identity with equal and opposite paired forces
claim: Paired internal force power equals force times relative velocity
not_proved: The force law, energy storage, dissipation sign, no-slip constraint or biological bonding
assumptions: q, v1 and v2 are real scalars. The paired force on the second point is defined to be -q. Equal velocities, constitutive force laws and any dissipation inequality are not assumed or established.
limitations: The force law, energy storage, dissipation sign, no-slip constraint or biological bonding.
statement_lean:
theorem paired_exchange_power (q v1 v2 : ℝ) :
    q * v1 + (-q) * v2 = q * (v1 - v2)
